title: DocGuard guard result
description: The decision fields and counts of `docguard guard --format json` (full and `--compact`), specs/106-field-report-fixes FR-011 and FR-012. Gate on `exitCode` or `outcome`: they are what the process exit code says. `errors` and `warnings` count each finding at its intrinsic severity, before strict mode, `findingSeverity` or `severity` reweight it; `effectiveErrors` and `effectiveWarnings` are the counts after that, and decide the exit code. Other fields are documented in AGENTS.md (Consuming Guard Output) and docs/configuration.md and are not listed here.

status.description: From the effective counts only: FAIL when effectiveErrors > 0, WARN when effectiveWarnings > 0. A strict run that exits 4 can say WARN or PASS here; read exitCode.

exitCode.description: The process exit code of this run.

outcome.description: Why the run exits with exitCode: 0 pass; 2 warnings; 1 errors; 3 not-initialized (errors in a project with no .docguard.json); 4 unexamined (strict: a validator that applies examined nothing, see strict.blocking) or undecided (--fail-on-inconclusive or requiredChecks).

errors.description: Findings at intrinsic severity error. Not the gate under strict: read effectiveErrors.

effectiveErrors.description: Findings that resolve to error after enforcement. exitCode is 1 or 3 exactly when this is above 0.

blocking.description: Validators that make the run exit 4 (outcome unexamined).

demotedProductSecrets.description: Possible secrets in product code that strict reports as warnings because the project did not turn security on.

unanalyzed.description: Files in a language DocGuard recognizes that some check does not read (specs/108-analysis-disclosure FR-002). Visibility only: never changes a finding or the exit code. The compact form keeps language and files.
